title: Group: SYS-G1 authentication, session and federation policy export
source_system: Group identity platform admin console (SYS-G1)
what_it_shows: Workforce identities for all divisions are unique and never reused. Number-matching MFA for all SYS-G1 workforce users; phishing-resistant hardware keys for administrators; lockout after 10 failed attempts for at least 30 minutes, with risk-based blocking; passwords of at least 12 characters checked against breached-password lists, no reuse of the last 4; replay-resistant protocols; re-authentication for privileged elevation and funding account changes. Sign-in pages show a use notice. SYS-M1 is federated to SYS-G1 for the dispute platform (SYS-P6) and the Software division's ISV support console

title: Group: SYS-G1 identity governance export and Q1 2026 certification results

Q1 2026 certification campaigns covered Payment Processing and Software division systems and privileged roles. SYS-M1 is not a source for workflows or campaigns

SYS-M1 users have no PAM

title: Group: endpoint, device compliance and remote access configuration
source_system: Endpoint management console; zero-trust access gateway
what_it_shows: Workstations lock after 15 minutes idle (10 minutes in operations centers); laptops have full-disk encryption and remote wipe; removable media blocked and software installation prevented on CDE hosts and administration workstations, which use application allow lists; only managed, encrypted devices with EDR can reach CDE administration, and mobile devices cannot; remote access to the CDE only through the zero-trust access service and PAM jump hosts, over TLS 1.2 or higher. Merchant Consulting laptops are enrolled in group EDR and vulnerability scanning since 2025-09

SYS-M1 sign-in logs onboarded since 2025-09. The source list does not include SYS-P6 application events (case views and exports) or consulting mailbox access logs

title: Merchant Consulting: SYS-M1 authentication policy, federation trust settings and user list

owner: Merchant Consulting security and compliance lead

The second factor is an SMS one-time code; there is no privileged access management. The tenant is federated to SYS-G1 for SYS-P6 and the ISV support console. title: Merchant Consulting: service catalog, client list and engagement letter template
source_system: Merchant Consulting contract records

No tax preparation, legal, attestation or federal contract work; engagement letters exclude PHI. The template requires client notice within 72 hours of a confirmed incident affecting client data and has no security, AI or PCI DSS acknowledgment terms; client questionnaires are answered case by case. Marketing pages promise bank-grade security
